summary: The manuscript correctly limits the failed budget-59 diagnostic to its unchanged relaxation. The selected degrees contribute 836, so 2P<=856, versus the relaxed 888. Yet L=31 requires 12P>=5263, contradicting 12P<=5136 for this tuple. Thus the diagnostic maximizer cannot itself witness sharpness. Other tuples and a universal formal bridge remain unchecked by this calculation; the report appropriately claims neither optimality of 53 nor impossibility of proving 52.
